reader_summary.headline: Ben & David are joined by special guest and Venmo cofounder Andrew Kortina for our first-ever SF live show!
reader_summary.overview: Ben & David are joined by special guest and Venmo cofounder Andrew Kortina for our first-ever SF live show! In front of a packed house we chronicle the journey of how two freshman-year roommates from Penn turned a healthy obsession with Craigslist and a fake podcast into an app that facilitated $17B of payments last quarter alone.
